title: when I do and when I've done

data.en: I'll call you again later when I arrive.
data.cn: 我稍后到达时会再给你打电话。
data.hint: when + present tense | 语法结构

data.en: We'll go out when it stops raining.
data.cn: 雨停了我们就出去。
data.hint: when it stops | 时间状语从句

data.en: When you are here again, you must come and see us.
data.cn: 你再次来这里时，一定要来看看我们。
data.hint: When you are | 条件状语

data.en: Don't forget to lock the door when you go out.
data.cn: 你出门时别忘了锁门。
data.hint: go out | 祈使句

data.en: What are you going to do while I'm away?
data.cn: 我不在的时候你打算做什么？
data.hint: while I'm away | 疑问句

data.en: Before you go, there's something I want to ask you.
data.cn: 在你走之前，我有件事想问你。

data.en: Wait here until I come back.
data.cn: 在这里等我回来。

data.cn: 伊恩在这里时什么也别说。

data.en: I'll come as soon as I finish.
data.cn: 我一结束就会来。
